_comment: Weapons the prologue script names or implies.
Kept in their own catalog because weapons are attached to character hands
at runtime rather than being part of the character mesh, which is what makes
the promotion visuals in brief section 31 possible later.

assets.subject: wooden practice sword with a plain rounded tip and a bound grip
assets.notes: Scene 02: lies beside the sleeping Rowan. The visual contrast with the Iron Sword he collects later is the point.

assets.subject: straight iron short sword with a plain crossguard and a leather-wrapped grip
assets.extra: blade slightly oversized for tactical-camera readability
assets.notes: Rowan's starting weapon, Attack +3. Collected in the equipment tutorial.

assets.subject: simple wooden mage staff with a forked head and a small unpolished violet stone
assets.extra: unpolished stone marks her as an apprentice, not a mage
assets.notes: Maeve's starting weapon. The stone should look cheap; her later staffs escalate from it.

assets.subject: long infantry spear with a leaf-shaped iron head and a bound ash shaft
assets.extra: long enough that the two-tile reach is legible on the grid
assets.notes: Tomas. Range 2 in battle 01's weapon-range tutorial, so the length has to sell it.

assets.subject: long straight officer's sword with a swept guard, wire-wrapped grip and a plain pommel
assets.extra: cleaner and longer than the iron sword
assets.notes: Shared by Aldric and Varric, recoloured per character.

assets.subject: crude notched iron cleaver with a bound wooden handle
crude goblin spear of lashed bone and scrap iron on a crooked shaft
assets.extra: visibly improvised next to the soldier spear

assets.subject: crude short bow of bent wood and sinew with a scrap-leather grip wrap
plain military short sword with a straight guard and a wooden grip
round wooden shield with an iron boss and a painted green field
assets.extra: the green field is the Greenvale faction read
assets.notes: Carried by guards and Tomas. Classed as a weapon so it shares the attachment pipeline.
